failure_interpretation: UNSAT or a rejected model is an encoding/wiring issue to investigate; a timeout is censored, not evidence that the mathematical witness is absent.
input_law: Oracle-assisted pins from Q1490 on Q1482 exact ordinary public target; correctness only.
measurement_scope: Known-witness CNF compatibility control; not unpinned PDP cost, natural yield, N83 success, or complete N131 work.
method: Append 327 unit clauses to a byte-identical Q1482 ordinary N53 CNF body, pinning four 53-bit leaf x coordinates, two 53-bit pair midpoint x coordinates, and nine target-selector bits to Q1490 target preimage index 141. Run Q1482 frozen native solver binary and independently verify its model against the original CNF, pins, three direct S3 links, and public group relation.
success_gate: SAT model satisfies unchanged Q1482 ordinary CNF plus witness pins and independently verifies the same four-point public relation.
